_comment: LICENCE: Hunyuan3D 2.1 is under the Tencent Hunyuan Community License, whose grant excludes the EU, UK and South Korea and calls use of the outputs there unlicensed. Kept deliberately for its mesh quality; see docs/guide/licensing. For an asset shipping worldwide use img2mesh_trellis.json (MIT, no territory clause).  AUTO_CLEANUP IS FALSE ON PURPOSE: with it true the ShapeGen node frees the pipeline after the run, but ComfyUI caches the loader node's output, so the FIRST run succeeds and every later one dies with "'Hunyuan3DDiTFlowMatchingPipeline' object has no attribute 'scheduler'" on the gutted cached object. Keeping the pipeline resident costs VRAM, and ComfyUI does not evict it: 3D-Pack keeps its Hunyuan pipelines in its own node cache, outside ComfyUI's model management, so POST /free does not release them and about 5GB stays held (measured; see scripts/asset_to_mesh.sh and docs/guide/textures). Run shapes and textures as separate batches with a container restart between them: every shape, restart, every texture, as scripts/asset_to_mesh.sh does. Interleaved, the TexGen pipeline left resident by one asset makes the next asset's ShapeGen die in its loader with `torch.OutOfMemoryError: Allocation on device`.
